answer_2.quote: Our evaluation of these LLMs reveals significant disparities in multilingual capabilities. DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates superior overall performance with an average of 75.5% across all languages... The performance generally correlates with model scale and architecture sophistication...

answer_4.quote: To rigorously evaluate the benchmark quality... we randomly sample 20 items from each of the 14 disciplines... each language evaluated by two professional translators... Each item undergoes assessment by two high-caliber translators who rate three aspects (accuracy, fluency, and completeness) on a scale of 1 to 5.
